description: Flag common style problems in an essay: sentences in the passive voice, sentences that start with the same word as a neighbour (or three or more times), filler words and phrases such as very, just, in order to, and sentences that are too long. Inputs: text, and optional max_sentence_words (default 30), the length above which a sentence counts as long. Sentence numbers start at 1 and follow the order of the text, so number 3 is the third sentence. The sentence_list field gives each passive or long sentence with its number, and the text summary ends with a line listing those numbers.     The checks are simple pattern rules, so treat them as prompts to reread, not as errors. Example: "Flag passive voice and filler words in my draft.

max_sentence_words.description: Sentence length that counts as long. Default 30.

name: style_flags
